# ankra_cost_autopilot_project_default (Resource)

One project's default cost autopilot tiers, layered over the organisation's (`ankra_cost_autopilot`). An environment kind the project leaves out follows the organisation default. The project's map replaces any earlier one as a whole. Changes need the `billing.manage` and `clusters.write` permissions across the organisation. Destroy removes the project's defaults, so its clusters follow the organisation's again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cost_autopilot_project_default" "payments" {
  project_id = "7e6f5a4b-3c2d-4e1f-a0b9-c8d7e6f5a4b3"
  defaults = {
    production = "managed"
    preview    = "ephemeral"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `defaults` (Map of String) Tier per environment kind. Kinds: `production`, `staging`, `development`, `preview`, `unknown`. Tiers: `hands-off`, `scheduled`, `managed`, `ephemeral`. At least one.
- `project_id` (String) Project the defaults apply to. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project id.
- `project_name` (String) Name of the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Project defaults are imported by project id.
terraform import ankra_cost_autopilot_project_default.payments 7e6f5a4b-3c2d-4e1f-a0b9-c8d7e6f5a4b3
```
